name: Hypothetical mmen-inspired material

evidence.basis: literature-anchored capacity and enthalpy with explicit unvalidated isotherm, water, kinetics and thermal assumptions
evidence.not_for: measured MOF ranking, lifetime, humid-mixture validation or hardware qualification

shaped_material.basis: 10 kg is a case input on a complete dry shaped-material basis
shaped_material.binder_support: No specific binder or support formulation is represented by this hypothetical package.
shaped_material.particle_geometry: Case input; not a measured pellet or coating.

co2.basis: single-site dry Langmuir anchored at one literature point

water.basis: unvalidated independent unary humidity stress law

co2_anchor.conditions: 2.0 mmol/g at 25 C and 39 Pa CO2; not a cyclic working capacity

assumptions: Single-site dry CO2 Langmuir behavior is assumed.
Independent unary water uptake is not a validated competitive humid-mixture law.
Illustrative LDF kinetics apply to all species.
Constituent and shaped-material thermal properties are engineering assumptions.

validity.temperature_C: No measured continuous range is claimed; model use is bounded by the package temperature limit.
validity.water: Fixed weather and official weather use the same gas forcing record.
validity.initial_state_interpretation: Equilibrated warm-start or clean-dry initial state is an explicit scenario basis and is not CSS.

uncertainty.statement: The missing uncertainty and material-specific validation are limitations, not zero uncertainty.
